product_one_liner.value: Malachyte helps e-commerce retailers personalize product search, recommendations, and shopping pages in real time from each shopper’s behavior, improving product discovery and revenue per visitor.
product_one_liner.notes: Malachyte describes its customer as retailers and says its search, recommendations, and page-personalization solutions adapt to shoppers; its homepage describes continuous adaptation to shopper intent and revenue-per-visitor improvement.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer expose no pricing link, and the pricing research says Malachyte does not publish rate-card pricing and requires a sales conversation; no public plans/pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Malachyte’s customer testimonial names BRUNT Workwear, and its case-study page names Jordan Craig. | named_customers.0: The customer testimonial names BRUNT Workwear. | named_customers.1: The case-study page is about Jordan Craig’s use of Malachyte.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom reports 17 employees, which falls in the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies New York City as headquarters. | hq_country: The company profile gives its headquarters as New York City, United States.

founded_year.notes: Dealroom identifies Malachyte as founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index labels the site “News & Stories” and lists mostly company, product, and marketing thought-leadership posts. It shows one clearly engineering/infrastructure-focused Google Cloud article, not the two engineer-authored build-focused posts required for a true result.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple setup guides, product guides, and technical references, satisfying the several-articles criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page says there are no open positions, so no AI/ML/data-science role is open.

model_provider.value: Its own proprietary two-headed transformer, branded Vector AI; Malachyte says it does not use a large language model.
model_provider.notes: The CEO says Malachyte uses its own proprietary two-headed transformer and does not use an LLM; the company calls its engine Vector AI. This identifies its proprietary model rather than an external provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Malachyte’s technology page states SOC II Type 1 certified and says it is compliant with GDPR; these support the normalized SOC 2 Type 1 and GDPR entries. | compliance_certs.0: The company’s technology page names SOC II Type 1 certification, normalized here as SOC 2 Type 1. | compliance_certs.1: The technology page explicitly states GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The August 2026 announcement explicitly describes the latest round as seed funding. | funding_date: The announcement is dated August 6, 2026, so the month is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The August 6, 2026 company funding announcement states the seed round was $10 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round announced August 6, 2026 falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page says no positions are open, so there is no current SDR/BDR/account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: TechCrunch reports that Malachyte became generally available to Shopify merchants through a native integration in June 2026, a major product availability launch within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile lists a current Malachyte VP, GTM position beginning March 1, 2026, inside the 12 months preceding November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Founding GTM job listing names HubSpot and Apollo as sales tools to use/test; Malachyte’s pilot/integration material names Salesforce among CRM systems. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job listing names HubSpot as a sales tool to use/test. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job listing names Apollo as a sales tool to use/test. | crm_stack_signal.2: The pilot/integration page names Salesforce.
